settings.heading: What Customers in Las Vegas Say
Ready to Start Your Project?
settings.sub_heading: Book residential services online with transparent pricing, or contact us for a custom commercial quote.

settings.question: How much does TV mounting cost?
settings.answer: Most of our residential service pricing is listed directly on our website. However, larger residential projects, custom installations, and most commercial projects may require a personalized estimate based on the scope of work. You can view pricing on our Residential and Commercial Services pages or contact us for a free estimate.

settings.question: Do you offer commercial services?
settings.answer: Yes, we proudly service businesses throughout the Las Vegas Valley, including offices, restaurants, bars, gyms, casinos, churches, and retail spaces. We understand unique commercial needs, such as multi-TV installations, conference room AV solutions, and flexible scheduling designed to minimize disruption to your daily business operations.

settings.question: How soon can you come out?
settings.answer: We often have same-day and next-day appointments available throughout the Las Vegas Valley. Contact us by phone or text, and we'll let you know our earliest availability.

settings.question: What are your hours of operation?
settings.answer: We are open 7 days a week from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. We also offer convenient after-hours appointments from 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.(Please note: Additional charges apply for after-hours scheduling).

settings.question: Are there any hidden fees or surprise charges?
settings.answer: No. We believe in honest, upfront pricing. For services with published pricing, you'll know the cost before scheduling. If your project requires a custom estimate due to its size or complexity, we'll discuss the scope of work and provide pricing before the job begins. We never perform additional billable work without your approval.

settings.question: What does your 5-Year Warranty cover?
settings.answer: Our 5-Year Installation Warranty covers defects related to our installation workmanship. If an issue arises because of the way we installed your equipment, we'll return and make it right at no additional labor cost. The warranty does not cover manufacturer defects, accidental damage, misuse, abuse, normal wear and tear, or damage caused by modifications or work performed by others.

settings.question: Are your technicians insured?
settings.answer: Vegas TV Mounting carries $1,000,000 in general liability insurance to fully protect your property and our craftsmanship. Every technician on our team undergoes rigorous background checks and extensive training to ensure your project is completed safely, cleanly, and professionally.

settings.question: Do you install Samsung Frame TVs?
settings.answer: Yes, we specialize in Samsung Frame TV installation. Because Frame TVs require precise, expert handling to achieve their signature flush-mount finish, we handle every detail from start to finish. Our specialized service ensures a flawless no-gap mount, seamless cable management, and full artwork display setup for that perfect, high-end gallery look.

settings.question: Can you help me choose the right solution for my project?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Whether you're unsure which TV mount, home theater setup, smart home device, security camera system, or commercial AV solution is right for your space, we're happy to make recommendations based on your needs, budget, and installation requirements.
